decision.explanation: The documents present three distinct individuals identified as husbands of different women named Chilonis: Cleonymus (husband of the daughter of Leotychidas), Acrotatus (also husband of the daughter of Leotychidas in a contradictory text segment), and Cleombrotus II (husband of the daughter of Leonidas II). The claim regarding Pyrrhus is rejected as it relies on a document explicitly stating it is a 'modified context' designed to replace the original reference, rather than factual evidence.
